stakes.name: Third Point Private Capital Income Fund

checks.msg: 2 holding(s) left out of the copy record because the ticker's price didn't match the price filed (often an old ticker now used by another company): HTZWW, KVUE.

summary: Concentrated: 40 holdings, but the top ten are 62% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 154% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 1.3 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced and faster-growing.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 4 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in 1961; Columbia. Worked in private equity, risk arbitrage and distressed debt before founding Third Point in 1995 with $3.3 million.
profile.approach: Event-driven and value-oriented, often buying into troubled companies and writing pointed public letters to their boards.
known: Yahoo (2012): joined the board after challenging the chief executive's CV. Sony (2013) and Nestlé (2017) campaigns.
Returned about 16% a year from December 1996 to December 2015.
profile.note: The 13F shows long US share positions only, not Third Point's credit or short positions.
